newsitem.title: FRANCE: Two burglars killed in shootout with French police.
newsitem.headline: Two burglars killed in shootout with French police.

text.p: Two burglars were killed and a policeman wounded in a shoot-out overnight when police surprised a gang of eight men looting a warehouse near this west French city, officials said on Wednesday.
Four people were arrested and two escaped and were being sought by police, they said.

There was no immediate indication of whether the burglars were the same gang of about eight which last week wounded four policemen with shotgun fire during a hold-up at a petrol station in the same area.
